dialog.agyInstall.title: Install Antigravity CLI?
dialog.agyInstall.detail: This step downloads Antigravity's official install script (install.ps1) from antigravity.google and runs it with PowerShell: a one-off download, only now and with your consent. Unless you store a key, the app makes no network requests of its own; with a Copilot key stored it requests api.github.com only, on its own at most once every 5 minutes (at most once a minute with Refresh), and only while that row is enabled. After the install, the status line bridge is added; the bridge reads only the remaining quota fraction and the reset time.
